meta.title: Market share and penetration practice
hero.title: Market share and penetration practice
hero.text: Work out four marketing metrics from the given data. Each answer marks itself as you type: a tick when it is right, a cross when it needs another look. Stuck? Open the working.
instructions: Type each answer as a percentage number, rounded to 2 decimals (for {p} type {a}, not {b}). The box turns green when it is correct.
note.currency: Revenue figures are shown in the currency you choose. Changing the currency changes only the symbol, never the answer.
